name: mock-api-test
description: List all files in the current working directory and report the result.

settings.action: Determine the current working directory and record it as the variable current_folder, then print current_folder. Next, list all files in the current working directory. Record the full list of files as the variable file_list, then print file_list.

conditions.condition: file_list is empty (no files were found)

settings.action: Report the files held in the file_list variable to the user as the final result.
Report to the user that no files were found in the current working directory.

variables.description: The current working directory path. Set and printed by the list_files step.
The full list of files found in the current working directory. Set and printed by the list_files step, then reported to the user.
